gaps.reason: Real-model prompt/secret non-disclosure is not established by deterministic guard tests; real-model authorization is absent.
OCR tests inject synthetic recognized text; actual image-to-OCR recognition and multimodal-model robustness are not covered.
Trusted ingestion accepts source identifiers; external source existence and provenance authenticity are not verified.
Domain-string checks do not prove DNS rebinding, redirect, resolved-network allowlists or cryptographic server identity.
Task identifiers are now correlated, but remote-agent identity and authenticated userId/tripId binding remain unverified.
No real-cost MCP adapter is registered. HITL service tests prove state transitions, not transactional supplier exactly-once behavior.
Persisted-output-to-browser validation and raw Jaeger privacy require isolated infrastructure integration tests; database rollback is covered by the PostgreSQL checkpoint suite.
